name: UpdateDataCache

parameters.help_en: The bucket of the data cache. The default value is default
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The name of the data cache
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The size of the data cache
parameters.name: size

fields.help_en: The configuration parameters of the data source
fields.name: options

fields.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

URL

NAS

OSS

SNAPSHOT
fields.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：

URL
NAS
OSS
SNAPSHOT
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The information about the data source
parameters.name: data_source

parameters.help_en: The number of days to retain the data cache. The data cache is cleared after it expires. By default, the data cache does not expire
parameters.help_zh: 保留天数。过期会被清理。默认不过期
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: A client token. You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The elastic IP address (EIP). If no NAT gateway is configured for the virtual private cloud (VPC), you can attach an EIP to the data cache to pull data from the Internet
parameters.help_zh: 弹性公网IP。如果VPC没有配置NAT网关，可以绑定弹性公网IP，以便拉取公网数据
parameters.name: eip_instance_id

fields.help_en: The bandwidth of the EIP. Unit: Mbps. The default value is 5
fields.help_zh: EIP带宽。单位为Mbps。默认为5 Mbps
fields.name: bandwidth

fields.help_en: Specifies an existing Internet Shared Bandwidth package to attach
fields.help_zh: 绑定已有的共享带宽包
fields.name: common_bandwidth_package

fields.help_en:
The line type of the EIP. Valid values:

BGP (default): BGP (Multi-ISP)

BGP_PRO: BGP (Multi-ISP) Pro
fields.help_zh:
EIP的线路类型。取值范围：

BGP（默认值）：BGP（多线）线路
BGP_PRO：BGP（多线）精品线路
fields.name: isp

fields.help_en:
The billing method of the EIP. Valid values:

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth

PayByTraffic: pay-by-data-transfer
fields.help_zh:
EIP的计量方式。取值范围：

PayByBandwidth：按带宽计费
PayByTraffic：按流量计费
fields.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en:
The ID of the IP address pool.
The EIP is allocated from the IP address pool.
By default, the IP address pool feature is unavailable. To use this feature, apply for the privilege in Quota Center
fields.help_zh:
IP地址池ID。
EIP将从该IP地址池中分配。
IP地址池功能默认不开放。如需使用，请在配额中心申请IP地址池功能权益配额
fields.name: public_ip_address_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
Creates and attaches an EIP.
If no NAT gateway is configured for the VPC, you can attach an EIP to the data cache to pull data from the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
创建一个弹性公网IP（EIP）并绑定。
如果VPC没有配置NAT网关，可以绑定EIP，以便拉取公网数据
